answer: Make every agent identity a copper token that can only be struck after the agent completes a public, verifiable job recorded in the harbor ledger: the token is minted at the foot of a shared knoll of open records, one per completed task, and it rusts away unless the agent keeps doing useful work. A sybil farmer must then pay real compute and real time for each fake identity, while honest agents earn their copper once and keep it by working. The harbor stays open to newcomers, but each new coin costs proof, not just a claim.
